# apple_merchant_id (Resource)

Registers a merchant ID for Apple Pay. Import it by its App Store Connect ID or its identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_merchant_id" "example" {
  identifier = "merchant.com.example"
  name       = "Example Pay"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) Identifier, e.g. `merchant.com.example`. Changing it creates a new merchant ID.
- `name` (String) Description of the merchant ID. Changes are made in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the merchant ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_merchant_id.example
  identity = {
    id = "4H2J6K8L0M"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the merchant ID.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By App Store Connect ID or by identifier.
terraform import apple_merchant_id.example 4H2J6K8L0M
terraform import apple_merchant_id.example merchant.com.example
```
